_comment: PHASE 1 (Goal 26). Every recorded sample the game plays, with its licence, its source and the peak MEASURED off the shipped file. Generated by tools/audio/build-audio.mjs from tools/audio/recipe.json; do not hand-edit. tests/audio-sample-licences.test.js fails the build if any entry lacks a licence, a source or a required attribution, so a file cannot reach a player without its provenance reaching the credits. Allowed licences are CC0 and CC-BY only — anything with a NonCommercial or ShareAlike term is refused, because this ships on Steam.
